symptoms: site bar bar database error de rahi hai
FATAL: sorry, too many clients already

diagnose.sql: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Threads_connected','Max_used_connections')
SELECT USER, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(COMMAND = 'Sleep') AS sleeping FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST GROUP BY USER ORDER BY n DESC
diagnose.look_for: one app user holding many sleeping connections

diagnose.sql: SELECT usename, state, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

causes.title_en: The app opens connections and doesn't close them (many sleeping/idle ones)
causes.title_hi: App connection kholti hai par band nahi karti (bahut saare sleeping/idle)

causes.title_en: Real traffic is higher than the limit
causes.title_hi: Asli traffic limit se zyada hai

causes.title_en: Slow queries keep connections busy, so new requests pile up
causes.title_hi: Slow queries connection pakde rehti hain, nayi requests line mein lag jaati hain

fixes.steps_en: Lower wait_timeout (MySQL) / set idle_session_timeout (PostgreSQL 14+) so idle connections close; fix persistent connections in the app.
fixes.steps_hi: wait_timeout kam karo (MySQL) / idle_session_timeout set karo (PostgreSQL 14+) taaki idle connection band ho; app ke persistent connections theek karo.

fixes.steps_en: Raise max_connections carefully (each connection uses memory), or add a pooler (ProxySQL / PgBouncer).
fixes.steps_hi: max_connections dhyan se badhao (har connection memory leta hai), ya pooler lagao (ProxySQL / PgBouncer).

fixes.steps_en: Open the Live tab, find the slow queries and run them through the query fixer.
fixes.steps_hi: Live tab kholo, slow queries dhoondo aur unhe query fixer se theek karo.

verify.en: Threads_connected / active connections stay well under the limit for a day.
verify.hi: Ek din tak connections limit se kaafi neeche rahein.

symptoms: special characters galat dikh rahe hain

diagnose.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, CHARACTER_SET_NAME FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND CHARACTER_SET_NAME IS NOT NULL AND CHARACTER_SET_NAME <> 'utf8mb4'

diagnose.look_for: latin1 or utf8 (3-byte) instead of utf8mb4

causes.title_en: The columns use latin1 or 3-byte utf8, which can't hold emoji/many scripts
causes.title_hi: Columns latin1 ya 3-byte utf8 mein hain, jo emoji/kai bhashayein nahi rakh sakte

causes.title_en: The app connects with the wrong character set
causes.title_hi: App galat character set se connect karti hai

fixes.steps_en: Convert the affected tables to utf8mb4 (ALTER TABLE ... CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) after a backup; check index length limits first.
fixes.steps_hi: Backup ke baad tables ko utf8mb4 mein badlo (ALTER TABLE ... CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci); pehle index length limit check karo.

fixes.steps_en: Set charset utf8mb4 in the app's DB config (Laravel 'charset' => 'utf8mb4', WordPress DB_CHARSET 'utf8mb4').
fixes.steps_hi: App ke DB config mein charset utf8mb4 karo (Laravel 'charset' => 'utf8mb4', WordPress DB_CHARSET 'utf8mb4').

verify.en: Save a test row with Hindi text and an emoji, read it back unchanged.
verify.hi: Hindi aur emoji wali test row save karo, wapas same padhni chahiye.
